description: benchmark v3: the table on index.html, recounted from the audit bundle (tools/cpu_table.py)

definitions.successful_candidates: distinct (run, epoch, tuple) among hit records
definitions.closure_hits: hit records (exact transfer hits, both closures counted)
definitions.verified_closures: hit records with verified == true (missing counts as false)
definitions.check_level: per run, from the worker source whose SHA-256 the run record gives: 'signed' if that source calls signed_check (signed transfer index = signed generator-DP index), 'absolute' if not (|index| = 24); a hit has the level of its run
definitions.distinct_rowspaces: distinct rowspace_sha256 of verified records, union over the lanes of a row
definitions.cpu: process CPU seconds, search and verification separately
